scenario: Batch delete rulesets across two repos from the spreadsheet textarea
preconditions: Requester has admin on both repos; the named rulesets exist
form_inputs: org, rulesets_csv with 2+ rows (repository,ruleset_name), approver, dry_run=true
expected_result: Status awaiting_approval; per-row plan to delete each ruleset; no mutation

scenario: Deleting an absent ruleset name is a no-op
preconditions: Requester admin; the named ruleset does not exist on the repo

scenario: A row for a repo the requester does not admin is rejected while other rows pass
preconditions: Requester admin on repo A but not repo B
form_inputs: rows for repo A and repo B
expected_result: Repo A row delete; repo B row rejected (unauthorized)

scenario: Tenant repo-admin team member authorizes a tenant repo without direct repo admin
preconditions: Repo resolves to a tenant; requester active member of that tenant X_RepoAdmin team

scenario: Live batch delete against real repositories
form_inputs: valid rows, dry_run=false, approver posts approved
expected_result: Rulesets deleted per row; per-row audit records applied/skipped/failed
